name: mike-mobile
description: Mike for iPhone and Android: a Capacitor shell around the hosted Mike web app.

scripts.sync: npm run www && npm run speech-model && cap sync
scripts.ios:add: npm run www && cap add ios && npm run ios:configure
scripts.android:add: npm run www && cap add android && npm run android:configure
scripts.android:sync: npm run www && cap sync android && npm run android:configure
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && cap run android --no-sync
